name: IDX
author: numbers-agent
description:
Discrete logarithm ('index' is the classical name for it, hence IDX). Clue is 'g h p' with p prime in [1e4,1e6). Solution: any x >= 0 with pow(g,x,p) == h. h is never 1 and never g, so the trivial answers 0 and 1 fail.
DIFFICULTY: hard. DISCOVERY PATH: three numbers, the last obviously prime-ish and largest; the demo answer is a number smaller than p. The relation is only found by trying modular operations -- pow(g,x,p)==h is the one that fits, and an AI given the demo triple plus answer will test that quickly. Gradient: a naive loop x=0.. finds the answer for the smaller p (and for lucky small x) inside a 1-second round, so a crude bot scores maybe a quarter of these; baby-step giant-step (m ~ 1000 steps, <1 ms) scores all of them. Verification is a single pow() call, so the scorer is tiny.
